question: Manoj starts from Point Y and drives 16 km towards north. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. He then turns right and drives 16 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Manoj starts from Point Y and drives 16 km towards north.

He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km.

He then turns right and drives 16 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/579497e3fd670f9741f773f0ae694675d77cfe21fadf98c16c9b3a08d63085d6.png] 

So, He should drive **8 km towards west** in order to reach Point Y again

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
